content.prompt: In the figure opposite, OC is perpendicular to OD and $OA=2OC$. B is a point on OD and $AB\parallel CD$. Prove that $\triangle AOB$ is similar to $\triangle COD$ and hence prove that $OB=2OD$.

spec.description: A-O-C horizontal andD-O-B vertical, ABparallelCD withsinglemarks, rightangleO, OA twiceOC statedonlyinstem. Directed extended source lines and all five labels retained.

answer.worked: $\angle AOB=\angle COD=90°$, and $\angle ABO=\angle CDO$ because $AB\parallel CD$. Hence $\triangle AOB\sim\triangle COD$ by AAA, with A matching C, O matching O and B matching D. Corresponding sides give $\frac{OB}{OD}=\frac{OA}{OC}=2$, so $OB=2OD$.
